description: This is a PHP source file implementing an API controller class for handling sale orders in OpenCart. It includes methods for loading order details, saving, commenting, confirming, and other order-related functionalities. The class interacts with models, sessions, and responds with JSON data, indicating it is part of an API backend.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale-related order API endpoints within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language, initializes order based on request parameters, and fetches order info from the model.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating an order based on posted data, responding with JSON status.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Records a comment for an order and responses with success or error in JSON.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms an order, validating cart stock and product requirements before confirming.
